name: QTU student membership
summary: Free Queensland Teachers' Union student membership for education students, which can be held alongside IEU-QNT membership.
key: FREE QTU and IEU-QNT STUDENT membership.
how: Fill out the dual application form, or join the QTU only at qtu.asn.au/join.
catches: No membership fees until you land your first job; you choose one union for full membership once you start paid work.

source.label: QTU: Student membership brochure and application form

evidence.quote: FREE QTU and IEU-QNT STUDENT membership
Education students are eligible for simultaneous membership of both of Queensland teachers' unions
You will not have to pay a dollar in membership fees until you land your first job
